2.0.0: (breaking change) MakeApiCall: headers and parameters changed from textarea/JSON string to key-value array inputs per standard #1459 (body remains textarea/JSON to support nested structures) — existing flows that used the old string-typed headers or parameters must be updated.
2.1.0: Added test() (Flow Test Mode) to all triggers: NewFollower, NewMention, NewReply.
2.1.1: MakeApiCall: Request Headers and Query Parameters set in the Designer are now sent. They were silently dropped: the key-value field stores its rows as a JSON object string, which the component did not parse.
